pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions or pyramiding within 3 ticks of high-impact session opens to eliminate falling-knife exposure.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated ATR-based volatility contraction breakout and a 3-period volume delta confirmation prior to order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate automated trailing profit locks via hard partial scale-outs once floating profit crosses +$10.00, forcing execution toward the $15-$30+ target zone.
